name: Servotech Renewable Power Ltd (erst. Servotech Power Systems)
tagline: EV-charger + solar-product + BESS manufacturer growing ~50-67% a year, but on thin ~10% EBITDA / ~5% PAT margins, ~47x earnings and a ~32% one-year drawdown - growth without the margin quality or valuation cushion for a 10x
business_overview: Servotech Renewable Power Ltd (NSE: SERVOTECH), renamed from Servotech Power Systems, manufactures EV chargers (AC/DC), solar inverters, solar PV modules/products, energy-storage systems and power-electronics components; offers end-to-end clean-energy solutions. Promoter holding ~58.6%.
fundamentals_table: 2026-05-04: Q4FY26 sales +49% YoY to Rs 217 Cr; net profit +38% YoY to Rs 11 Cr; OPM 8% -> 10%; QoQ PAT -31%
Revenue +66.6% YoY to ~Rs 211 Cr; EBITDA +70% YoY
fundamentals_narrative: Servotech is growing fast - FY26 revenue ~Rs 721 Cr with quarterly YoY growth in the 49-67% range - but the quality is the problem. EBITDA margin is ~10% and PAT margin ~5.5%, both thin and volatile (QoQ PAT -31% in the Sovrenn print), in a business - EV chargers and solar products - that faces intense domestic competition and Chinese import pressure. The stock still trades at ~47x earnings after a ~32% one-year fall, so a further 10x (to ~Rs 18,600 Cr) would need PAT to rise ~15x from ~Rs 40 Cr while the multiple stays elevated. The quality gate (durable margins, real returns) is not met, and there is no valuation margin of safety.
technical_read: Not pulled - no dedicated thread; stock down ~32% over the year.
sentiment_summary: No dedicated ValuePickr thread (Step 3.05: forum search surfaced only unrelated EV threads). Research is web/filings-based only.
bse_notes: Sovrenn note (2026-05-04): Q4FY26 sales +49% YoY to Rs 217 Cr, PAT +38% YoY to Rs 11 Cr, OPM 8% -> 10%, QoQ PAT -31%. The QoQ PAT decline and sub-10% operating margin are the tell - growth is real but not translating into durable profitability.

value_chain.theme: EV charging + solar products / BESS (component + equipment manufacturing)
value_chain.position: Manufacturer of EV chargers, solar inverters/modules and storage systems - equipment layer, competing on price and volume
value_chain.bottleneck_node: None held - cells, power semiconductors and connectors are sourced; charger and inverter assembly is contestable
value_chain.note: Priority-2 EV / BESS theme. India's EV-charging build-out is a real tailwind, but charger and inverter manufacturing is a low-moat, price-competitive layer with many entrants and Chinese import pressure - thin margins are structural, not transient.

drivers: some operating leverage as volume scales
earnings_quality.normalised_note: Margins are already thin (~10% EBITDA, ~5.5% PAT) and volatile QoQ; the risk is that they stay compressed, not that they fall from a peak.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: Quarterly revenue YoY roughly +49% to +67% through FY26; but PAT growth lags (+38% YoY in the Sovrenn quarter) and fell QoQ - profit is not compounding with the topline.
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: ~47x trailing after a 32% fall still demands rapid, sustained EPS growth; with margins stuck near 5% there is no cushion if growth slows.

bull_case: Fast revenue growth (~50-67% YoY) in EV charging and solar products - real end-market tailwinds
Broad product range (AC/DC chargers, inverters, modules, storage) and end-to-end positioning
Stock has de-rated ~32% - some froth removed
bear_case: Thin, volatile margins (~10% EBITDA, ~5.5% PAT); QoQ PAT -31% in the latest print - growth not converting to durable profit
Still ~47x earnings after the fall - no valuation margin of safety for a 10x
EV-charger / solar-product manufacturing is low-moat, price-competitive, exposed to Chinese imports
No ValuePickr thread or community/institutional scrutiny; Sovrenn datapoint unverified against filings
verdict_headline: Fast growth but thin margins, rich valuation and a low-moat product set - fails the quality gate and leaves no room for a 10x; thesis_fit 'neither', conviction Low
verdict_reasoning: Sovrenn-news seed (tier 4.65). The Sovrenn trigger (Q4FY26 sales +49% YoY, PAT +38%) is real but the same line shows the problem - OPM only ~10% and QoQ PAT -31%. Growth is not translating into durable profitability.

Even applying the trailing-vs-live-inflection latitude, the quality gate (durable margins, real returns) is not met: ~10% EBITDA / ~5.5% PAT margins are structural for a price-competitive EV-charger / solar-product manufacturer facing Chinese imports, and the stock is still ~47x after a 32% fall - no margin of safety. thesis_fit 'neither'.

Live-theme match: EV / BESS, priority-2 (value_chain added) - but the exposure is the low-moat equipment layer. No red flag (profitable, promoter ~58.6%, no SEBI/auditor issue). conviction Low; revisit_after_30d false.

four_box.note: value_chain explicit: 'None held - cells, power semiconductors and connectors are sourced; charger and inverter assembly is contestable' (moat=no); India's EV-charging build-out 'is a real tailwind' (yes); but '~10% EBITDA / ~5.5% PAT margins are structural' and '~47x... no margin of safety' (valuation=no).
